meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用分子特征预测化合物毒性等性质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果研究化学或药物,需要预测化合物性质
copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties like toxicity from structural data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in chemistry or pharma and need to predict compound properties

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 DeepChem 加载分子数据(SMILES、SDF、FASTA),把分子转成 ML 可用的特征,训练传统机器学习或图神经网络模型,预测溶解度、毒性等性质,并跑 MoleculeNet 基准数据集。
howto.when: 当你要做分子性质预测(如 ADMET、毒性)、加载分子数据,或使用 MoleculeNet 基准数据集时会触发。

say.text: 用 Delaney 数据集训练一个溶解度预测模型并给出 R²
在 Tox21 上微调 ChemBERTa 做分类

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude loads molecular data (SMILES, SDF, FASTA), converts molecules into ML-ready features, trains traditional ML or graph neural network models, predicts properties like solubility and toxicity, and runs MoleculeNet benchmarks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want molecular property prediction (e.g. ADMET, toxicity), to load molecule datasets, or to use MoleculeNet benchmark datasets.

say_en.text: Train a solubility model on the Delaney dataset and report R²
Turn the SMILES in molecules.csv into ECFP fingerprints and split by scaffold
Fine-tune ChemBERTa on Tox21 for classification
